hugotiers.config.title: HUGOTiers Tagger Settings
hugotiers.config.enabled.tooltip: Draws the rank next to player nametags. Turning this off hides everything the mod adds.
hugotiers.config.rainbow.tooltip: Animated colour-cycling outline around the badge.
hugotiers.config.mode.all.tooltip: Shows every kit the player has been tested in.
hugotiers.config.mode.cavekit.tooltip: Shows only the Cave rank. Players without one get no badge.
hugotiers.config.mode.crystalfight.toolt: Shows only the Crystal rank. Players without one get no badge.
hugotiers.config.mode.macefight.tooltip: Shows only the Mace rank. Players without one get no badge.
hugotiers.config.ttl.tooltip: How long a looked-up rank is reused before it is fetched again.
hugotiers.config.api.tooltip: Full address including https://. Turns red while unusable — an invalid address is discarded instead of saved.
